prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 89.4%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 73.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 37.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Waiting Final Setup Account Link Reorder: Move sign-in after the waiting step so account linkage occurs only after pet render preparation completes. (why: Sign-in screen stalls caused support complaints and deferring account connection until post-waiting avoids authentication blocking render wait times.)
1: [choose_path, layout] Mascot Guided Intro Path Split Layout: Change the choose_path layout to a split view featuring a guide mascot contrasting preset adopt vs custom creation paths. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s, indicating user hesitation when picking between onboarding routes.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Tray Accessibility & Control Quick Guide: Revise home_intro copy to highlight system tray controls, desktop hotkeys, and hiding options. (why: Support receives consistent queries regarding how to talk to, move, or hide the desktop pet after finishing onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud Pet Save Safeguard Assurance Badge: Add a visual sync guarantee badge on the sign_in screen confirming pet profiles are bound permanently to the account. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back into their account.)
4: [finish, notification] First Desktop Pet Arrival Sound Alert & Banner: Play a pleasant companion chime audio effect and display a visual banner on screen when reaching home_intro. (why: 3 support tickets reported that the pet did not show on desktop or users were unsure if setup completed.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in reduces stall friction, though sign-in conversion is already 94.6%.
Split visual layout targets high decision hesitation (514s mean time) at choose_path.
Copy update directly addresses frequent support queries at high-dropoff finish step (26.5% loss).
Assurance badge is low-cost and directly addresses 8 support emails regarding saved state.
Audio/visual arrival feedback clarifies setup completion for the 26.5% finish dropoff.
